# Winners Circle Barbershop

> South Austin barbershop based in Austin, Texas. Skin fades, curly tops, beard line-ups and designs under the hex lights on Jones Rd in South Austin. Owner-run, casual but professional, and every cut gets the details right.

- Phone: (512) 701-0592
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Sunset Valley, Manchaca, Buda, Kyle
- Google rating: 5.0 from 235 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/winners-circle-barbershop/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/winners-circle-barbershop/book.html

## Services
- Skin & taper fades: Clean, blended fades from skin to taper, finished sharp every time.
- Curly tops & texture: Curls and thick, wavy hair shaped by barbers who know texture.
- Beard & line-ups: Beard shaping, line work and a tidy finish to go with the cut.
- Hair designs: Lines and parts cut in by hand, from simple to bold.
- Kids & senior cuts: Patient, kid-friendly cuts for the little ones, and a discounted classic cut for seniors.
- Classic cuts & braids: Classic cuts tailored to your style, plus braids on weekends with the shop's visiting braider.

## About
Winners Circle Barbershop opened in 2025 at 2619 Jones Rd in South Austin, in the brick strip with the black porch rails, the barber pole by the door and The Sweet Grind and Aura Island Grill in the same lot. It's owner-run. Justin Nicks brings a military background and a calm, precise hand to fades, tapers and beard work. Co-owner Devry Weaver, born and raised in Beaumont, is known for patience with kids, consistent blends and sharp line-ups. Trey, Paul and MJ round out the chairs. One regular has been getting cut by MJ since MJ was cutting in his garage. Inside it's all black walls, glowing hexagon lights and ring lights at every chair. This isn't a rushed, in-and-out shop: listen first, then cut, then refine, so you leave confident and sharp every time.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday and Tuesday 10am to 5pm, Wednesday and Thursday 10am to 5:30pm, Friday 9am to 5:30pm, Saturday 9am to 3pm. Closed Sunday.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes. The shop runs appointment-first, but walk-ins are welcome when a chair is open. Book online to lock in a time.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book on Vagaro or Booksy, book Devry directly on TheCut, or call (512) 701-0592.
- Q: How much is a haircut?
  A: Haircuts start at $40, skin fades at $45 and haircut and beard at $55. The full menu is on the services page and on Vagaro.
- Q: Do you do braids?
  A: Yes, on weekends with the shop's visiting braider. Braids are by appointment only, no walk-ins. Braid pricing is on Vagaro.
- Q: Do you cut kids' hair?
  A: Yes. Kids are welcome, straight or curly hair, and designs too. Plenty of families bring their boys and teens here.
- Q: Where is the shop?
  A: 2619 Jones Rd, Suite C, Austin, TX 78745, in South Austin, in the same lot as The Sweet Grind and Aura Island Grill. Parking right out front.
